body:
## Pensieve 0.5.2

### Fixed
- **Pages:** Backspace on an empty first line now deletes it, so a block (an AI conversation, a table) can start the page; the cursor moves up to the title.
- **Speak a page:** "a document titled X, with a level-one heading Y…" names the page X and makes Y a real heading (no more "# " left as text).
- **Email:** garbled Chinese in mail text and attachment names (GBK sent without a charset or labelled as UTF-8, raw GBK file names, characters split between encoded words), on the computer and on the phone. Garbled names of mail you already have are shown correctly too; Chinese .txt / .csv attachments and imported files are read in the right encoding.
- **Paper questions:** the question leaves the box as soon as you press Enter; the microphone button no longer covers the box and the Send button (the box has its own microphone).
- **Paper highlights:** text under a highlight can be selected again; the selection bar no longer jumps to the end of the paper.

### New
- **Click a highlight** to change its colour, add a comment, or read and edit the one you wrote. In *Notes*, clicking a card takes you to the passage in the paper and flashes it.
- **Translations are kept** with each paper on your device — come back days later and they're still there, with no new AI call.
- **Smarter page translation:** formulas and tables are shown exactly as in the paper (never translated), figure and table captions are translated as captions, and text inside figures is left alone.
- **iCloud Drive sync** (Settings → Sync & devices → Cloud sync → iCloud Drive) between Macs, iPhones and iPads — and Windows with iCloud for Windows. Android phones can't reach iCloud: mix them with Apple devices through Jianguoyun (坚果云).
- **Updates** are also checked when the computer wakes from sleep, and again 10 minutes after a check that failed.

### Download

| Your system | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 / 11 | **Pensieve-Setup-0.5.2.exe** |
| Mac with Apple Silicon | **Pensieve-0.5.2-mac-arm64.zip** |
| Mac with Intel | **Pensieve-0.5.2-mac-x64.zip** |
| Linux (64-bit) | **Pensieve-0.5.2-linux-x86_64.AppImage** or **Pensieve-0.5.2-linux-amd64.deb** |
| Android 8+ (HarmonyOS via 卓易通) | **Pensieve-0.5.2-android.apk** |
| iPhone / iPad (iOS 15+) | **Pensieve-0.5.2-ios-unsigned.ipa** — install with Sideloadly or AltStore ([how](https://photonghost308.github.io/pensieve-app/#ios-install)) |

Already using Pensieve? It updates itself (Settings → General → Updates). Your notes stay as they are.
name: Pensieve 0.5.2
